caption: The video captures a close-up, low-light view of intensely glowing molten material. A bright white-yellow channel of liquid runs diagonally from the upper-left into a luminous pool at the lower-center, its edges flickering while its overall form stays steady. To the right lies a dark, rough, crust-like mound that remains in place. The nearly black background is filled with numerous small bright sparks and embers suspended in the air. These airborne particles continuously shift position, appearing as short bright streaks that drift through the scene, their density and brightness fluctuating. A faint yellowish haze in the upper-right area gradually spreads outward, becoming more diffuse across the upper portion of the view. The channel, pool, and mound hold their positions, while particles and smoke move within it.
